d.d: Any of several fibrous mineral forms of magnesium silicate, used for fireproofing, electrical insulation, building materials, brake linings, chemical filters, suits, fireman's gloves, etc.
d.x: All types of asbestos are potentially carcinogenic when inhaled.

d.d: Any of asbestos-like forms of several minerals, asbestiforms
The supposed material composing part of the body that is impervious to heat, or by extension other unpleasant sensations; especially hot or spicy food.
To coat or line with asbestos.
To expose to asbestos; to cause to suffer asbestosis.
